calculation_handling.description: For a complete zoning by-law amendment application filed on or prior to March 31, 2025, the listed current bicycle parking regulations do not prevent the project if it complies with the former Chapter 970 clauses.
calculation_handling.gaps: Application filing dates are not held; the former Chapter 970 path is never evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Defines a complete application for a zoning by-law amendment as one meeting Official Plan Policy 5.5.2.

230.90.15.2(1).explanation: Current bicycle parking rules do not block a project with a complete zoning by-law amendment application filed on or before March 31, 2025, as long as it follows the earlier Chapter 970 bicycle parking clauses.

230.90.15.2(2).explanation: A complete application for a zoning by-law amendment means one that satisfies Official Plan Policy 5.5.2.
